preconditions.description: The number of intersections n and roads m must be within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: All roads must connect valid intersections and cannot connect an intersection to itself.

preconditions.expression: 2 <= k <= n and len(path) == k and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in path)
preconditions.description: The path must contain valid intersections and have a length equal to k.

preconditions.expression: all(path[i] != path[i + 1] for i in range(k - 1))
preconditions.description: All intersections in the path must be distinct.

preconditions.expression: all((path[i], path[i + 1]) in roads for i in range(k - 1))
preconditions.description: The path must consist of valid roads in Bertown.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum and maximum number of rebuilds separated by a space.
The number of rebuilds must be non-negative.
The minimum number of rebuilds must not exceed the maximum number of rebuilds.
